name: Tally
description: Tally.so is a versatile form-building platform that allows users to create forms quickly and efficiently without any coding knowledge. It offers a user-friendly interface and a variety of customization options to suit different needs, making it ideal for businesses, educators, and individuals looking to gather information seamlessly.
